baseline.method: Unmodified full original16-state least-squares decomposition, twice bit-identical; five equivalent Cartesian fields

channel_metric_definition: Each complete signed channel uses Frobenius(error)/Frobenius(reference), no crop/mask/alignment/gain.
provenance: Frozen before local reconstruction using actual full original repetitions and float32 serialization; fixed1e-6 channel tolerances exceed10x serialization. Forward limit1.01*original residual+1e-6 retains actual restricted-model mismatch.
